  - #703 [94m]8;id=1an7iy5;https://github.com/harrisoncramer/weave/issues/703\https://github.com/harrisoncramer/weave/issues/703[39m]8;;\ — PR 696 put the panel's and [38;5;153mweave rpc[39m's clients on xhttp's transport, which has a 30s ResponseHeaderTimeout. Connect unary handlers send no headers until they return, so a create whose provisioning plus pre-launch hook runs over 30s now fails
    client-side, and the hang-up cancels the request context, which kills the script via exec.CommandContext. Proved both halves against the real agentv1connect handler: 32s handler fails on [38;5;153mxhttp.NewClient(0)[39m, succeeds on old [38;5;153mhttp.DefaultClient[39m; handler ctx cancelled at 30.002s. MCP tools already had a 30s
    cap before this range; noted as related.
